audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle while the packet chart and the already-applied mirror both read Skill, Skill, Neeko, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle — and the page's own whys agree with the packet, not with the sides ('even trade' on row 2, 'the one window your melee range out-trades her' on row 3, 'the lane tips to her' on row 4).
audit.why: Rows 2-5 are sided against the text printed next to them. The mirror (kayle__neeko) has already flipped rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the packet values, so my side must state the same rows or mirror-fix will overwrite them.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side to Skill, win[2]/phases[2].side to Neeko, win[3] and win[4] with their phases to Kayle, all as matched pairs, plus phases[2].rating rescaled to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that none of Kayle's abilities are ever named. The full-layer phase rows are pure boilerplate ('Trade Q on his CS timings', 'Stormsurge spike') and say nothing about what Kayle actually does on those levels.
audit.why: The decisive interactions are Radiant Blast at 900 range slowing and shredding resistances, Divine Judgment making her untargetable through Pop Blossom's damage, and her passive range growth kiting Tangle-Barbs' 1000. Naming them is what turns the rows into advice.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why, phases[4].why and phases[5].why now name Radiant Blast, Divine Judgment and the Nashor's range spike.
sources: kit: Kayle P/Q/R text and ranges

audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 is defensible: the packet records only 8 games at 37.5%, far too thin to move a rating on, and the mechanical read is genuinely split — Neeko owns level 3 outright and loses everything from her first item.
audit.corrected: Left diff, diffRating and carryRating untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Grievous Wounds anywhere, though Celestial Blessing heals her on a flat 15s cooldown.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal here: Neeko's damage is chip-and-burst and her W heals straight through the chip half, so anti-heal timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now buys Oblivion Orb and names the ability being cut.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tells the player that Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset, so the burst tell is the wind-up rather than a spell cast.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags autoreset-burst-tell. A player watching for an ability animation sees nothing and eats the missing-health damage; the readable cue is the attack that comes early.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the reset and its 8s cooldown alongside Divine Judgment's 160s.
sources: kit: Kayle E autoReset flag, cd 8/7.5/7/6.5/6

edits.before: Trade Q on his CS timings and hold E for the step-up. The disguise resets every bad position you take.
edits.after: Radiant Blast slows and shreds your resistances from 900 — hold Tangle-Barbs for her step-up, not for the wave.

edits.before: Pop Blossom online — your all-in is a setup puzzle: E root, walk in as a clone or minion, R the panic.
edits.after: Pop Blossom is online, but Divine Judgment blanks it — kill her before she reaches 6, or bait the ult first.

edits.before: Stormsurge spike — a rooted target now loses half their HP to one rotation.
edits.after: Nashor's turns her ranged form on and she kites your 1000-range Tangle-Barbs.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. Check it before every step-up. - W clone + disguise is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — 160s at rank 1; invulnerability blanks your Pop Blossom burst, so bait it before you commit. - Starfire Spellblade is an auto reset on 8s at rank 1 — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Stormsurge into Sorcerer's Shoes; then Shadowflame and Zhonya's into dive.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. First: Stormsurge into Sorcerer's Shoes; Oblivion Orb — Celestial Blessing heals her.

notes: The mirror's author flagged that the content whys array sits one row out of step with the phase labels (whys[3] is under 'Levels 4-5' but reads like level 6). I followed the same choice: sides flipped to the packet chart, why text left alone, because shifting the whys down a row is a seven-row rewrite that a human should sign off on. Note also that the full layer calls Kayle 'he/his' throughout (enemyWin, tradeGood, breakdown.wave, dosFull, report[3].t) while the content layer says 'she' — template-wide, not a matchup fact, so untouched.
